description: Mortgage, HELOC and reverse mortgage servicers
coverage_notes: [mortgage-servicers] CURRENT STATUS (after third review 2026-10-02): 489 entries - 130 detailed (all 130 verified) and 359 roster; 62 rows have no website. Detailed-entry link fill: view_bill 82%, pay_bill 97%, autopay_setup 77%, autopay_cancel 51%, statements_history 76%, paperless 55%, payment_assistance 91%, escrow_analysis 39%, tax_form_1098 48%, payoff_request 53%. Review 2026-10-02 changes: (1) Completeness - re-matched every company in rosters/mortgage_servicers_cfpb.csv and added 9 unmapped ones: Real Time Resolutions (138 complaints, HELOC/second-lien servicer; detailed), Rosegate/Nexus Nova (ServiceMac-subserviced; detailed), NewDay USA (parent Chrysalis Holdings; detailed), and roster rows for Aspen Yo, Brightfunders, Lil' Wave Financial, AMA Advisors, Morgan Stanley Private Bank and Double Diamond-Delaware. Upgraded State Home Mortgage (Georgia DCA servicer), Servion (credit-union subservicer) and Credit Union Mortgage Association to verified detailed entries, and found websites for 11 more roster rows: 9 confirmed by fetch (MortgagePros, Independence Home Loans, Panorama/SimplyPMG, Weststar, West Coast Servicing, GITSIT, Equity Resources, Affiliate Mortgage Services/Neighborhood Capital Funding, Nationwide Equities) and 2 left unverified because of bot blocks (Madison Management, CU Alliance). James B. Nutter, HomeTown Lenders and One Reverse Mortgage are marked defunct pointers. (2) Accuracy - re-fetched pages for about 40 detailed servicers. autopay_cancel was added from published ACH-authorization terms for Cenlar (and Citi, Ally, PrimeLending and SSFCU, which Cenlar subservices), SPS, Regions, Midland, BSI, Planet, 21st Mortgage, CHFA, Union Home and Freedom, plus Veterans United's help center. Earlier notes saying SPS and Planet publish no stop-autopay terms were wrong and are corrected. Veterans United, CMG and PrimeLending were rebuilt from their servicing sites. Ally, EverBank and Ameris now link to their subservicers (Cenlar, LoanCare and Dovenmuehle). The Mr. Cooper statements link pointed at the sunset page and was replaced with Rocket's transferred-loan FAQ. A staging-host link (servsol.infomedia.dev) was removed from ServiSolutions. (3) Reverse mortgages (15 entries): fetched sources show Celink has serviced HUD's Secretary-held HECMs since 2022 (it replaced NOVAD) and has subserviced Mutual of Omaha's reverse loans since 2020. The HUD, NOVAD, Mutual of Omaha and RMF legacy entries were corrected and verified, and the wrong 'RMF' alias on the Mutual of Omaha entry was removed. The history of earlier passes follows; counts quoted inside it were true at that pass. 490 entries: 89 detailed (support/how-to links researched; 75 verified by fetching official pages 2026-09-29) and 401 roster-tier. Completeness checked against the CFPB Consumer Complaint Database company list for mortgage/reverse-mortgage/HELOC products 2023-2026: every company with >=270 complaints is a detailed entry or is mapped to one (companies with 100-270 such as Data Mortgage/Essex, Lennar, FourLeaf FCU, FCI Lender Services, Arvest, Ameris, BNY Mellon, Discover, SoFi, Better remain roster-tier) (e.g., Specialized Loan Servicing -> Shellpoint/Newrez, Caliber -> Newrez, Home Point -> Mr. Cooper/Rocket, USAA -> Nationstar subservicing, Citi/Ally -> Cenlar, AAG -> FAR, RMF -> Longbridge/Celink/Ginnie Mae), and all remaining companies with >=5 complaints are roster entries (credit bureaus, law firms, title companies, data vendors, solar lenders and home-equity-investment firms excluded). Scope list from the task is fully covered: Mr. Cooper/Nationstar, Rocket, PennyMac, Freedom, Lakeview/LoanCare, Newrez/Shellpoint, Wells Fargo, Chase, Carrington, Cenlar, Dovenmuehle, Flagstar, PHH/Onity, Selene, SPS, Midland/Rushmore, U.S. Bank, Truist, Guild, Planet; reverse: Celink, Onity/PHH Reverse, FAR (incl. AAG), Longbridge, Champion (Lakeview), Mutual of Omaha, HUD Secretary-held HECMs, RMF legacy. Unverified detailed entries (site blocked automated fetch; data from search snippets): Fifth Third, Huntington, KeyBank, BMO, Citi, PenFed, AmeriHome, Village Capital, Valon, Rate/Guaranteed Rate, Figure, RMF legacy, Mission, Alabama HFA. Roster entries have website only when matched to sibling bank/credit-union files or a well-known homepage (verified=false). REVIEWER PASS 2026-09-29: A second pass checked every link in the detailed entries with an HTTP status check and a scan for soft-404 pages (about 500 URLs), then fetched about 45 pages in full. Fixes: the Lakeview /statements-payments/ URL (now redirects to the home page), Fairway /payment-assistance (404, removed), TD manage-your-loan (redirected), the Mutual of Omaha pay page (moved), and AmeriSave /servicing/ (now /help). Autopay-cancel links were added for Freedom, Bank of America, Silver Hill (including a cancellation form), USAA and Mutual of Omaha, plus statements, escrow and assistance links for USAA, SPS, Carrington, loanDepot, NAF, KHC, Virginia Housing and SC Housing. Two defunct brands were removed from the roster: Caliber Home Loans, which merged into Newrez in 2023, and Home Point, whose servicing went to Mr. Cooper (now Rocket). Both are recorded in the surviving entries' notes and aliases. Five roster entries were upgraded to verified detailed entries: Essex Mortgage (Data Mortgage Inc., 259 complaints), Arvest, Gateway First, NC SECU and Banco Popular de Puerto Rico. Totals after review: 488 entries, 94 detailed, 80 verified. Link coverage among detailed entries: view_bill 65/94, pay_bill 84/94, autopay_setup 53/94, autopay_cancel 18/94, statements_history 50/94, payment_assistance 61/94. Autopay-cancel is null for most servicers because they document cancellation only inside the logged-in portal or by phone. Reverse-mortgage servicers have no monthly payment, so autopay does not apply to them. Several bank sites (53.com, huntington.com, key.com, penfed.org, bmo.com, pnc.com, flagstar.com, rocket.com, help.valon.com, amerihomeservicing.com) block automated fetches, so their entries stay as previously recorded or unverified. The reviewer had no web-search budget left (the session cap had been reached), so new URLs were found only by following links on official pages. SECOND REVIEW PASS 2026-09-30: (1) Accuracy - an HTTP status sweep of all 585 URLs in detailed entries found no real 404s; every non-200 was bot blocking (403/429/timeouts at pnc.com, key.com, bmo.com, huntington.com, penfed.org, arvest.com, flagstar.com, valon/amerihome Zendesk), and those sites were then read in a real browser. Pages were fetched in full for about 30 detailed entries, including every one previously marked unverified. Fifth Third, Huntington, KeyBank, BMO, PenFed, Valon, Citi, AmeriHome, Rate, Village Capital, Mission Servicing, Figure and Alabama HFA/ServiSolutions are now verified, with corrected or added pay, autopay, autopay-cancel, statements, paperless and assistance links, plus phone numbers and mail addresses. Rocket's old servicing.rocketmortgage.com links now redirect to the Rocket Account login and were updated. Village Capital /paymentoptions/ moved to /resources/payment-options/. Autopay-cancel links were added for Huntington, KeyBank, BMO, PNC, FCI, FourLeaf, HSBC and Triad, and statements or paperless links for Carrington, Planet and Citizens. (2) Completeness - ten roster entries were upgraded to verified detailed entries: FCI Lender Services (128 complaints; site moved to myfci.com), FourLeaf FCU (144), Lennar Mortgage (170), Ameris (122; subserviced by Dovenmuehle), HSBC (95; subserviced by Dovenmuehle), Triad Financial Services (a manufactured-home lender), Midwest Loan Services (a credit-union subservicer), and Third Federal/TFS (70). The CFPB company 'Peer Advisors, LLC', with 275 complaints of which 262 are reverse-mortgage complaints, is Celink's parent. It is now mapped to the Celink entry as an alias with its complaint counts, and it was the largest unmapped reverse-mortgage complainant. Discover Home Loans is kept as a pointer entry: Discover (now Capital One) stopped servicing home loans on 2026-02-02, and Capital One services no residential mortgages. (3) Processors were identified: Dovenmuehle behind HSBC and Ameris; ServiceMac/HavenWallet behind AmeriHome; ICE LoanSphere behind Lennar, Mission, ServiSolutions and PHFA. Totals after this pass: 488 entries, 102 detailed (101 verified; only the RMF legacy pointer is unverified) and 386 roster. Link coverage among detailed entries: view_bill 74, pay_bill 94, autopay_setup 66, autopay_cancel 26, statements_history 61, payment_assistance 73. payment_processor is filled for 97 of 102. LINK BACKFILL 2026-09-30 (link-backfill-mortgage-servicers pass): file now has 492 entries (122 detailed, 370 roster). Re-fetched ~5,400 public help/FAQ/payment pages already discovered from each detailed servicer's sitemap and same-site links (read-only GETs), pattern-matched for escrow analysis, Form 1098/year-end statements, payoff-statement requests, autopay cancellation, paperless, statement viewing and hardship, and hand-reviewed every proposal (roughly 40% rejected: bank-wide deposit/credit-card pages, Canadian TD pages, first-time-buyer or PMI-cancellation articles, other-product payoff pages). New link keys: links.escrow_analysis, links.tax_form_1098, links.payoff_request, links.property_charges (reverse). Detailed-entry fill rates before -> after: view_bill 74% -> 76%, autopay_cancel 34% -> 40%, paperless 45% -> 50%, statements_history 69% -> 69%, payment_assistance 80% -> 81%, escrow analysis 19% -> 37%, Form 1098 page 0% -> 40%, payoff request 0% -> 45%. JavaScript-only portals (LoanCare help center, Midland, Celink reversedepartment.com) were read in a browser where possible. Roster websites: 205 roster rows lacked a website; 122 now have one, found by fetching candidate official domains and accepting only pages naming the company (and usually its NMLS ID); 6 of those are verified=false because the page did not name the legal entity. 83 roster rows still have no website (search budget exhausted; NMLS Consumer Access is not machine-readable without a browser session). Reverse mortgages: 14 entries (was 8): added alias entries for AAG (-> Finance of America/Celink), Liberty Reverse Mortgage (-> Onity reverse; Liberty site retired 2026-03-23), NOVAD (former HUD Secretary-held HECM contractor; novad.com no longer resolves -> HUD FHA Self Service Portal) and Mutual of Omaha Reverse; recorded property-charge (tax/insurance/HOA) default options, LESA, repayment plans, payoff and heirs pages for Onity reverse, Longbridge, Celink, FAR and HUD; re-typed Reverse Mortgage Investment Trust and One Reverse Mortgage roster rows as reverse-mortgage. LINK BACKFILL PASS 2 (2026-10-01): web-search budget was exhausted, so roster websites were found only by fetching candidate official domains and accepting pages that name the legal entity (8 more rows now have websites: First Home Mortgage NMLS 71603, Central Mortgage Funding NMLS 1699966, FEMBi NMLS 162197, Temple View Capital Funding, Nexera Holding/Newfi NMLS 1231327, Weichert Financial Services, Advantage Credit (credit-report vendor, not a servicer); Standard Mortgage Corporation (stanmor.com, NMLS 44912) and Note Servicing Center (NMLS 270925) were upgraded to verified detailed entries. 74 roster rows still lack a website. Re-checked help pages of ~45 detailed servicers for autopay-cancel/paperless text; added Carrington autopay management and Movement e-statements; SPS, Planet, Movement, Valon, Cenlar, Statebridge and loanDepot pages were confirmed (fetched) NOT to publish stop-autopay steps, which is now recorded in each entry's notes with the phone number to call. Detailed fill rates now: view_bill 77%, autopay_cancel 40%, paperless 51%, statements_history 70%, escrow analysis 37%, Form 1098 42%, payoff request 46% of 124 detailed entries (123 verified). LINK-BACKFILL REVIEW (2026-10-01, skeptical second pass): (1) Accuracy - HTTP status sweep of all 860 URLs in detailed entries: 716 returned 200; the rest were bot blocks (403/429/HTTP2 stalls at pnc.com, key.com, spservicing.com, bmo.com, pennymac.com, shellpointmtg.com, help.valon.com and others), not dead pages, except loanDepot's servicing.loandepot.com/sign-in (404, login_url changed to consumerportal.loandepot.com). Page text was re-read (WebFetch, curl, public Zendesk API or browser) for 26 detailed servicers: Fay, ServiceMac, loanDepot, Union Home, AmeriSave, Rocket, Valon, Statebridge, AmeriHome, Truist, Freedom, Midwest Loan Services, Gateway, Selene, Kentucky Housing, THDA/VMLS, Cenlar, Longbridge, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Chase, Pennymac, Celink, plus failed reads of Guild, Vanderbilt, Citizens, Synovus and Essex (JS shells or 403). Fixes: Fay login moved to the ICE LoanSphere portal and New-to-Fay page added for view/autopay/paperless (agent hours corrected to Central Time); ServiceMac login moved to LoanSphere (myservicemac); Pennymac autopay_cancel now the specific cancel-draft FAQ; Valon 1098 and payoff articles added and escrow-analysis link corrected; Statebridge and AmeriHome 1098 articles; Truist and Cenlar 1098 pages; Cenlar payoff; KHC ACH form; THDA Paymentus login and autopay-cancel deadline; Union Home payoff_request removed (page does not cover payoffs) and support phone added. (2) Duplicates and mergers removed (12 roster rows), each recorded as an alias plus a note in the surviving entry: SC Housing and Volunteer Mortgage Loan Servicing (duplicates of detailed HFA entries), Paramount GR Holdings -> PRMG, Old Republic National Title Holding -> Old Republic Title Holding, Academy and Cherry Creek -> Guild, Bay Equity -> Rocket, Summit Funding -> CrossCountry, Sierra Pacific -> Union Home, Sandy Spring -> Atlantic Union, HarborOne -> Eastern Bank, Comerica -> Fifth Third. (3) Roster websites confirmed by fetch: American Bancshares Mortgage (myabsm.com, NMLS 217378), Intercontinental Capital Group (NMLS 60134; site shows copyright 2023), Hanwha Qcells (us.qcells.com; EnFin solar financing), Rock Holdings (Rocket parent; verified=false), Goal Structured Solutions (goalsolutions.com; verified=false). Candidate domains for about 40 other no-website rows were fetched and rejected (parked "/lander" pages, unrelated businesses or no DNS).

REVIEW 2026-09-30 (fetched in browser; servsol.com now loads - the earlier 403 was bot blocking): Payment Information page lists free online one-time payments by 7pm CT via Servicing Digital (portal down 7pm-midnight CT), free monthly auto drafts (Auto Draft Authorization Form), free phone payments, mail, lobby drop box and Western Union; cash, debit and credit cards not accepted; FAQ covers canceling a one-time draft scheduled in error. Manage Your Account page: Servicing Digital shows balances, transaction history, tax/insurance-paid notices, and free paperless statements; 'Glance' co-browse help from customer service is useful for seniors and caregivers. The site banner on 2026-09-30 reported technical difficulties and longer phone waits. entries.senior_programs: Serves 62+ borrowers: repayment plans for delinquent property taxes/insurance, foreclosure avoidance/loss mitigation, annual occupancy certification, language line. Property-charge (tax/insurance/HOA) default repayment plans and At-Risk Extension request for critical circumstances, both on the Foreclosure Avoidance page.
entries.notes: Borrower Portal (JS; read in browser). Make a Payment page: payments on approved Repayment Plans (property-charge arrears) and voluntary prepayments - online one-time (no account needed) via DirectBiller, phone 877-342-4480, mail; electronic payments cannot be cancelled once submitted. Contact page: property tax dept accepts paid tax receipts (Property.TaxDocs@reversedepartment.com, fax 626-543-1945, PO Box 2515 Covina CA 91722); insurance policies PO Box 39457 Solon OH 44139-0457 or https://www.expressinsuranceinfo.com/3142530. Common questions: direct deposit, line-of-credit draws, payoff quote, third-party authorization. No autopay concept for reverse loans (no required monthly payment). REVIEW 2026-09-30: the CFPB complaint database files Celink complaints under its parent 'Peer Advisors, LLC' (275 mortgage-product complaints 2023-2026, 262 of them reverse mortgage - the second-largest reverse-mortgage complaint count after Ocwen/Onity). Peer Advisors acquired Celink in 2013 (HousingWire/BusinessWire, search results). Complaint counts are recorded here, so Peer Advisors needs no separate roster entry. 2026-09-29 reverse-mortgage backfill: the reversedepartment.com Foreclosure Avoidance page, read from the portal's public page bundle because the site is a JavaScript app, covers property charges. Borrowers with a Property Charge Default (unpaid taxes, insurance or HOA dues/assessments that the servicer advanced) may qualify for a repayment plan. They complete the Repayment Plan Review Request, which includes a Financial Budget Worksheet, while speaking with a servicing representative. The page also covers the Annual Occupancy Certification, which can be done by phone, online or on the form; completing required repairs; keeping at least one borrower on title; paying in full or refinancing; short sale; deed-in-lieu; the At-Risk Extension request for critical circumstances; and free HUD counseling at (800) 569-4287. Spanish and interpreter line: (866) 654-0020. Borrower Care hours are 8am-7pm Mon-Thu and 8am-5pm Fri ET. Reverse mortgages have no required monthly payment, so autopay does not apply; repayment-plan and voluntary payments are made on the Make a Payment page. Paperless: the portal has a /paperless route that works only after sign-in, and there is no public how-to page. 2026-09-30: reversedepartment.com pages render only with JavaScript and returned no content in an automated browser this date; Longbridge's public servicing page (same Celink Borrower Care, 866-654-0020) documents the property-charge default options and payoff-quote form. LESA: if the loan has a Life Expectancy Set-Aside, the servicer pays taxes/insurance from it; otherwise the borrower pays them directly and sends proof (property tax dept and insurance addresses above). REVIEW 2026-10-02: Celink also holds HUD's contract for servicing assigned Secretary-held HECMs (since 2022, replacing NOVAD; HousingWire, fetched), and has subserviced Mutual of Omaha Mortgage reverse loans since 2020 (PR Newswire 2023, fetched).
entries.escrow_info: Reverse mortgages: borrower pays property taxes/insurance directly unless LESA set aside; Celink tax dept (888) 825-3802 and insurance dept (866) 871-2412.

CFPB 2023-2026: FAR 115 reverse complaints, AAG 25. 2026-09-29 reverse-mortgage backfill (FAR loans are subserviced by Celink on reversedepartment.com): the reversedepartment.com Foreclosure Avoidance page, read from the portal's public page bundle because the site is a JavaScript app, covers property charges. Borrowers with a Property Charge Default (unpaid taxes, insurance or HOA dues/assessments that the servicer advanced) may qualify for a repayment plan. They complete the Repayment Plan Review Request, which includes a Financial Budget Worksheet, while speaking with a servicing representative. The page also covers the Annual Occupancy Certification, which can be done by phone, online or on the form; completing required repairs; keeping at least one borrower on title; paying in full or refinancing; short sale; deed-in-lieu; the At-Risk Extension request for critical circumstances; and free HUD counseling at (800) 569-4287. Spanish and interpreter line: (866) 654-0020. Borrower Care hours are 8am-7pm Mon-Thu and 8am-5pm Fri ET. Reverse mortgages have no required monthly payment, so autopay does not apply; repayment-plan and voluntary payments are made on the Make a Payment page. Paperless: the portal has a /paperless route that works only after sign-in, and there is no public how-to page. 2026-09-30: reversedepartment.com pages render only with JavaScript and returned no content in an automated browser this date; Longbridge's public servicing page (same Celink Borrower Care, 866-654-0020) documents the property-charge default options and payoff-quote form. LESA: if the loan has a Life Expectancy Set-Aside, the servicer pays taxes/insurance from it; otherwise the borrower pays them directly and sends proof (property tax dept and insurance addresses above).

entries.name: HUD / FHA - Secretary-held HECM reverse mortgages and FHA Partial Claims
entries.parent_company: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
entries.service_area_detail: HECMs assigned to HUD (typically when balance reaches 98% of max claim) are held by the Secretary; borrowers use the HUD FHA Self Service Portal. FHA partial-claim second liens (interest-free, due at payoff/sale) are also paid to HUD.
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-800-CALLFHA (1-800-225-5342), M-F 8am-8pm ET; Federal Relay 1-800-877-8339; HECM counselor referral (800) 569-4287
entries.mail_payment_address: Partial claim payoffs by check payable to HUD: ISN Corporation, Attn: PARTIAL CLAIM CASH MANAGEMENT, 2000 N Classen Blvd, Suite 3200, Oklahoma City, OK 73106 (online via Pay.gov preferred)
entries.senior_programs: HECM borrowers submit annual occupancy certification, proof of paid property taxes and insurance declarations via the HUD FHA Self Service Portal; can request monthly statement, payoff statement, line-of-credit funds. Free HUD-approved HECM counseling (800) 569-4287.
entries.notes: Single Family Servicing page (hud.gov/program_offices/housing/sfh/nsc redirects here) documents the HUD FHA Self Service Portal for HECM borrowers, email answers@hud.gov, and partial-claim payoff instructions (Pay.gov or mail to ISN Corporation). HECM home page links HECM Counselor Roster and HUD Lender List Search. 2026-09-30: Secretary-held HECMs (assigned to HUD) were for years serviced for HUD by contractor NOVAD Management Consulting; novad.com no longer resolves (DNS failure 2026-09-30). Current HUD Single Family Servicing page (fetched) directs HECM borrowers to the HUD FHA Self Service Portal to submit proof of paid property taxes, insurance declarations and annual occupancy certification, and to request monthly statements, payoff statements or line-of-credit funds; email answers@hud.gov; 1-800-CALLFHA. REVIEW 2026-10-02: Correction (fetched HousingWire article and HUD Single Family Servicing page): Celink (Compu-Link Corp.) replaced NOVAD as HUD's contractor for servicing assigned Secretary-held HECMs and HECM subordinate mortgages in 2022 (contract: one base year plus four option years, i.e., potentially through 2027). NOVAD has not serviced these loans since 2022. HUD's page now directs HECM borrowers to the HUD FHA Self Service Portal for proof of paid property taxes, insurance declarations, annual occupancy certification, monthly/payoff statements, line-of-credit draws and third-party authorization; the contractor may still send statements under its own name, so borrowers should follow the contact on their latest statement.
